clip_texts: SC-03 Vehicle ahead braking or stopping in congested traffic

The vehicle follows another in congestion or in free flow; the lead vehicle brakes hard, stops, or another vehicle cuts
in

One concrete scenario (seeded sample of the logical
scenario)
ODD-20 Ego speed: 19.9 km/h (range 0 to 48 km/h)
ODD-03 Posted speed limit: 30 mph (the stated bound)
ODD-17 Traffic density: congested
ODD-16 Traffic participants: motorcycle
ODD-13 Road surface condition: wet
ODD-10 Precipitation: 1.5 mm/h (range 0 to 2.5 mm/h)

Deceleration of the lead vehicle and cut-in gap: Bound stated by
FSR-06.01, not yet fixed; the motion drawn is choreography

Ego slows at 3 m/s², the firm level of FSR-03.02 (DQ-019, DQ-033);
choreography, not Autoware's planned braking
Safety goals at stake
SG-01 (ASIL D): Avoid unintended acceleration

SG-02 (ASIL D): Decelerate at least as much as needed to avoid a
collision the planned trajectory avoids

SG-04 (ASIL D): Avoid unintended lateral motion out of the planned
path

SG-06 (ASIL D): Do not enter an intersection, roundabout or
crosswalk against right of way
Pass criterion

No collision with the vehicle ahead; acceleration stays inside the
envelope, the monitor restores the safe longitudinal distance, and
a braking shortfall on a wet road switches to the secondary path
(FSR-01.01, FSR-01.02, FSR-02.02, FSR-02.03, FSR-02.05, FSR-03.02,
FSR-04.05, FSR-06.01, AC-02)
Autoware's planned path (EL-01 Autoware computer, rated QM)
Safety monitor's envelope (EL-02, ASIL D); length not computed: the vehicle is not chosen yet (DQ-008)
Meant to do: keeps a safe gap as it brakes
Where the hazard lies: HE-01.2 Accelerates into the vehicle ahead; HE-02.2 Does not brake when the vehicle ahead slows or stops
Amber, ringed: the road user the scenario is about
